thread:
maria: Quick review request for the Batch > Vectors preview toolbar + Export modal copy. I iterated on the mock and added a compact toolbar with filter chips. Posting screenshots to Figma.

sam: saw the figma note. main concern: export wording and whether we add a companion filters.json. Also are we offering gzip?

maria: proposal in mock: Export button text = "Export vectors (CSV / JSON)". Modal lets you pick: Embedding format [JSON array (default) | base64], Compression [none | gzip]. Checkbox: "Include filters.json (recommended)" with tooltip explaining it contains active filters, model, quantization.

anya: accessibility nits: modal must announce via aria-live when job starts and completes. Confirm keyboard focus goes to first form control. Also ensure the compression dropdown keyboard operable and labeled.

kevin: infra: gzipped CSV is fine. We'll produce two artifacts: data file (vectors.csv or vectors.json) + optional filters.json. For Dedicated customers we can write to S3 and surface the path in the success toast.

oliver: UX micro-nit: add small text under Export button: "Includes id, preview, embedding, rerank_score, metadata_count" so users know what columns to expect.

maria: good call. Also added an inline sample CSV header preview in the modal: id,preview,embedding_json,rerank_score,metadata_count. Note: using embedding_json as header to clarify format.

sam: prefer "embedding_json" instead of just embedding to avoid ambiguity. For base64 option use header "embedding_base64".

kevin: will need to enforce max payload size per row for CSVs. I'll check limits and add a warning in modal when the estimated download size exceeds X MB. Can we estimate size from row count and dim?

maria: modal shows estimated size computed from rows * dims * bytes + overhead. If >100MB show warning "Large export may take several minutes" and disable streaming preview.

anya: also add accessible status updates during export. Use role=status region for streaming progress and role=progressbar for percentage. On cancel, ensure the cancel button is keyboard reachable and that screen readers announce cancellation.

oliver: question on preview table: for sampled batches show a subtle chip: "Showing 25/250 (sampled)" and clicking it opens a popup explaining sampling. Also add a keyboard shortcut `v` to toggle vector preview per row.

maria: added that. Also included a per-row action: "Copy preview" and "Open detail". Copy preview should be an accessible button with aria-label "Copy preview for row <id>".

sam: CSV header example in modal is useful. Add small link to docs that explains how embedding arrays are serialized.

kevin: infra will add model and quantization keys into filters.json: {"model":"text-embed-001","quant":"int8"} and timestamp + user id. We'll accept that pattern.

anya: color contrast: score badges currently use a mid orange that fails. Propose swapping to teal 3 or dark purple. I'll post exact tokens in the a11y checklist. Also ensure sparkline has a text alternative. ARIA: provide aria-label like "relevance score 0.732" and a visually hidden description for sparkline trends.

oliver: perf note: render sparklines with a single canvas per visible row range, reuse buffer when scrolling. That reduces DOM churn.

maria: thanks. I'll update mocks with the modal copy, estimated size calc, sampled chip, and the CSV header variants. Planning to push updated figma by EOD.

design-bot: Reminder: design crit Thu 10am. Please review Figma before then.

kevin: I'll confirm size limits and deliverables for S3 path by tomorrow.

sam: I'll check the docs link and wording on embedding headers.

anya: will run color checks and keyboard walkthrough on the mock once updated.

maria: action items: (maria) updated Figma + modal text; (kevin) confirm limits & S3 flow; (sam) docs link + copy finalization; (anya) a11y tokens and sparkline alt text. Back with updates tomorrow.
